nodes.name: Receive health.json
nodes.notes: Production URL: https://n8n.kjnet.us/webhook/indienodes-member-health -- the value member-health-scheduled.yml's resume_url input is set to by the dispatcher workflow. Responds immediately: the GitHub job fire-and-forgets this POST and never reads the response, so there is no reason to hold its connection open through the Gotify chain. This workflow must be published for the production URL to be live.

nodes.name: Track streaks
nodes.notes: Tracks consecutive broken results per URL; healthy/warning results reset the streak. Stores a complete report for every received run, including healthy runs. Reports expire after 30 days. Sends one summary item to Gotify per run.

parameters.message: ={{ $json.summary.membersChecked + " member(s), " + $json.summary.urlsChecked + " URL(s): " + $json.summary.healthy + " healthy, " + $json.summary.broken + " broken, " + $json.summary.warnings + " warning(s).\n\n[Full member health report](" + $json.reportUrl + ")" }}

nodes.name: Alert via Gotify
nodes.notes: Credential: Gotify API. Set 'URL' to your Gotify host and 'App API Token' to an application token from Gotify's Apps tab. Not clickUrl: that Options field does not exist in the Gotify node as shipped in n8n 2.36.9 (added later, on a version past what this instance runs) -- confirmed against the actual 2.36.9-tagged source, not the master branch. Any value set there gets silently dropped since the node's own property schema does not declare it. Markdown content type + an inline [text](url) link is what n8n 2.36.9's Gotify node actually supports, and it's honest about the tradeoff too: the raw OS push banner shows unrendered markdown syntax, the link only becomes tappable once the message is opened in a Gotify client that renders markdown (confirmed for the web UI and the Android app).

nodes.name: Report webhook
nodes.notes: Production URL: https://n8n.kjnet.us/webhook/indienodes-member-health-report?token=<token>. Unauthenticated by design -- there is no login system for this instance to check against -- gated only by the token being an unguessable value 'Track streaks' generates and never logs anywhere public. Reports self-prune after 30 days (see 'Track streaks').

nodes.name: Build report page
nodes.notes: Styling ported from indienodes-app's scripts/n8n/build_workflows.py (the review_style CSS and html() page-shell helper Webring - Review Action v2 uses for its own approve/reject status pages), trimmed to what this page needs.

nodes.name: TEST trigger (delete when done testing)
nodes.notes: Manual fault-injection path for testing the alert + report page end to end without waiting on a real 404 or three real weekly cycles. curl -X POST https://n8n.kjnet.us/webhook/indienodes-member-health-test-trigger (no body needed). Feeds a synthetic already-at-streak-2 result into the SAME 'Track streaks' node the real webhook uses, so streak math, report generation, and the Gotify alert are all the real code path -- only the input is fake. DELETE this node and 'TEST: seed near-threshold streak' (and the one connection they add into Track streaks) once you're done testing; nothing else depends on them.
